changes.evidence: Deadpool: Ajax (Francis Freeman) is the leader of the Workshop, the illegal program that tortures terminally ill recruits like Wade to trigger mutations and sells the survivors as slaves. He runs it with Angel Dust and keeps running it after the lab fire, until Deadpool kills him. The X-Men Movies Wiki infobox lists The Workshop as his affiliation and calls it 'a top-secret illegal research organization', a modern-day subsidiary of Weapon X. This is a new name, taken plainly from the wiki. If the owner would rather use an existing group, 'Weapon X' is the parent organisation.

Deadpool: Angel Dust is Ajax's assistant in running the Workshop. She got her own mutation from the program, and she fights for him at the scrapyard. The X-Men Movies Wiki infobox lists The Workshop as her affiliation, and its Members list has her as 'Assistant and Former Patient'. New name, same as for T:fox-ajax (Weapon X is the parent organisation).

X2: she serves Stryker only under his Mind Control Serum, so that is not membership. Deadpool & Wolverine: the Void variant is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen and fights the Resistance at the assault on Nova's lair. The MCU Wiki infobox affiliation is Cassandra Nova's Henchmen, and she is in that group's member category. New name, the same one zout_01 proposed for T:cassandra-nova. An earlier owner call on T:fox-sabretooth asked whether Nova's forces count as a group, so this should follow that ruling.

Deadpool & Wolverine: Blob lives in the Void 'under the command of Cassandra Nova' as one of her henchmen and is the one who opens the gate of her compound. Blade's rocket kills him when the Resistance attacks. The MCU Wiki infobox affiliation is Cassandra Nova's Henchmen. New name, the same as zout_01 used for T:cassandra-nova. This depends on the same open question as the Sabretooth owner call.

Spider-Man (1967), episode 19 (Season 1 19A, 'To Catch a Spider'): Dr. Noah Boddy breaks Electro, the Green Goblin and the Vulture out of jail, and 'they formed the team known as the Spider-Catcher[s]' to destroy Spider-Man. All four are beaten and jailed. Marvel Database has a team page, Spider-Catchers (Earth-6799), with Boddy as its leader and his own page gives that affiliation. New name, taken plainly from Marvel Database. The wiki files these characters under Earth-6799, while the app uses Earth-67 for this show. If this is accepted, T:sv-electro-1967, T:sv-green-goblin-1967 and T:sv-vulture-1967 (outside this chunk, also groups []) should get the same stage.

X-Men '97 episodes 13-14 (Season 2 episodes 3-4): Nathaniel Richards used future technology to become the pharaoh Rama-Tut of ancient Egypt. He rules from his stronghold with a court (Candra) and soldiers (General Logos). After he loses the Celestial Ship to En Sabah Nur, he 'considered his efforts in the Ancient Egypt complete and departed that time period'. He abandons Candra and flees in his time machine. A ruler of a nation counts under the rules. New name: the source names Egypt plainly, and no existing group fits. The departure in episode 14 also needs left = ["X-Men '97"].

owner_calls.question: On screen, Hammerhead is the Big Man's (Tombstone's) enforcer and lieutenant until Tombstone fires him after the Valentine's Day summit (episode 23). Add a stage for Tombstone's organization plus a departure, or keep no groups? The app has no group for the Big Man's organization, and T:sv-big-man-ssm also has groups []. This question was already raised in an earlier pass (gout_35/36, sample_owner_calls).
options: Keep groups [] (Tombstone's organization is not tracked as a group)
Add [["<Big Man's organization>", "(from the start)"]], then Independent at The Spectacular Spider-Man with left = ["The Spectacular Spider-Man"], and give T:sv-big-man-ssm the same group
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: he 'worked at the employ of L. Thompson Lincoln, the crimelord also known as The Big Man and Tombstone'. He hires the Enforcers and Shocker and runs the OsCorp deal for Tombstone. After the summit, 'Tombstone fired him and threatened to kill him', and he goes into hiding. The affiliation reads 'Formerly: Big Man; Silvermane'. His time with Silvermane, 12 years earlier, is backstory. Neither wiki names the organization.

owner_calls.question: Mila Masaryk (Unicorn), Dmitri Smerdyakov (T:sv-chameleon-yfnsm) and Mikhail Sytsevich (T:sv-mikhail-yfnsm) are a four-person robbery crew, with Roxanna Volkov. She breaks the others out of prison, then uses Mikhail as bait and he turns on her. Should this unnamed crew count as a gang group, or stay with no groups?
options: Keep groups [] for all three (an unnamed crew, not a tracked gang)
Add a crew group (e.g. "Unicorn's Crew", a coined name) from the start for all three, with Independent and left for Mikhail (and for Mila) in episode 5 when the crew breaks apart
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'With his trio of partners Roxanna Volkov, Mila Masaryk and Mikhail Sytsevich they committed a robbery and were pursued by the police until Mila exited the moving vehicle...' (Season 1 4). 'Mila freed her partners and Dmitri and Roxanna fled' (Season 1 5). Each one's affiliation lists only the other people. Neither the episode pages nor the character pages name the crew.

owner_calls.question: The Counter-Earth Electro is a Bestial guard at the High Evolutionary's Wundagore Castle. Is that membership of the High Evolutionary's forces? The app uses The Knights of Wundagore for the High Evolutionary, Lord Tyger, Sir Ram and Lady Vermin, but Marvel Database does not list Electro as a Knight.
options: Keep groups [] (a guard, not a listed Knight)
Add [["The Knights of Wundagore", "(from the start)"]] (treating the High Evolutionary's Bestial forces as the Knights)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'He is a guard in the High Evolutionary's main base Wundagore Castle' (Spider-Man Unlimited episode 8). Marvel Animated Wiki: 'working as a guard for the High Evolutionary in his base Wundagore Castle'. The Knights of Wundagore (Earth-751263) members are Lord Tyger, Sir Ram, Lady Ursula and Lady Vermin, with no Electro.

owner_calls.question: The X-Men Movies Wiki infobox lists X-Force as one of Russell's affiliations, but its relationships section files X-Force only as 'Allies'. Is Russell an X-Force member by the end of Deadpool 2, or does he keep no groups? Essex House is an orphanage/school, so it is left to the owner's separate ruling.
options: Keep groups [] (X-Force are his allies, not his team)
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool 2: Deadpool, Cable and Domino stop Russell at the Essex House, and Deadpool's sacrifice ends his thirst for revenge. The biography never says he joins X-Force. The infobox gives 'Essex House for Mutant Rehabilitation; X-Force'.
